collection.title: Toyota Aygo 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Toyota Aygo 2005 to 2014 model requires a 26" wiper blade, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Aygo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
